title: Older Adult Activity: An Overview
claims: Adults aged 65 and older need aerobic, muscle-strengthening and balance activities each week.
The aerobic target is at least 150 minutes at moderate intensity, 75 minutes at vigorous intensity, or an equivalent combination.
Older adults need at least two days of muscle-strengthening activity each week and should also include activities that improve balance.
People benefit from physical activity throughout life, including as they age.

verification.note: CDC 页面正文完整可读，落地 URL 与源 URL 一致；页面标注 Dec. 4, 2025，与 publishedAt 一致；正文为英文。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“If you are 65 or older, you need aerobic, muscle-strengthening, and balance activities each week.”
原文：“At least 150 minutes at moderate intensity… Or 75 minutes at vigorous intensity. Or an equivalent combination at moderate and vigorous intensity.”
原文：“At least 2 days of activities that strengthen muscles” 是对肌力活动的天数要求；平衡活动另列为 “Activities to improve balance”，未给每周天数。
原文：“People benefit from physical activity throughout life, including as they age.”
